title: Finding Sine and Cosine from Tangent in Quadrant I
author: Muhammad Abdullah Athar
problemStatement: Given that \tan x = 2 and x \in [0, \pi/2], find the exact values of \sin x and \cos x.

steps.title: Use the Secant-Tangent Pythagorean Identity
steps.explanation: Substitute tan x = 2 into the identity 1 + tan^2 x = sec^2 x to find sec^2 x = 5.
steps.why: Dividing sin^2 x + cos^2 x = 1 by cos^2 x yields 1 + tan^2 x = sec^2 x.

steps.title: Determine Cosine in Quadrant I
steps.explanation: In Quadrant I, all trigonometric functions are positive, so sec x = sqrt(5) and its reciprocal is cos x = 1/sqrt(5).
steps.why: Cosine is strictly positive on [0, pi/2).

steps.title: Determine Sine Using Tangent and Cosine
steps.explanation: Multiply tan x = 2 by cos x = 1/sqrt(5) to obtain sin x = 2/sqrt(5).
steps.why: Since tan x = sin x / cos x, multiplying both sides by cos x gives sin x = tan x cos x.
